title: Heart Sutra 2 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the Heart Sutra in San Miguel de Allende, opening with a partner exercise in which pairs ask each other what they want to offer the world. Participants report in Spanish: one hears only "love" and doubts she can believe in her own capacity, another finds her eyes watering, and another settles on silence and listening. Nomon then turns to Avalokiteshvara, "the one who hears the cries of the world," pictured with hundreds of arms, at least one hand empty. Nomon explains emptiness as a Sanskrit term close to zero, then has the group look at a sheet of paper and name what is inside it: a tree, human sweat, a town, ambition. Nomon ends on a cliffhanger, promising the answer next week.
